# Mara Finds the Burned Ledger Leaf

Mara lifts a loose stone beside the western brazier and finds the charred ledger fragment beneath it. Nessa sees the fragment but not every surviving mark before Mara pockets it.

Possession does not explain who burned it or what the coordinate means.
